titulo: GTA 6 Music Festival Announced For Miami With A Stacked Lineup Of Artists
texto: Rockstar Games has announced Grand Theft Auto 6: The Festival, a concert coming to the Mana Wynwood in Miami on November 21. The festival features a lineup of artists from the game and the official soundtrack , including Cardi B, Travis Scott, Kodak Black, and Justice. The event is sponsored in part by PlayStation and produced by the team that created the III Points event in Miami. The "one-of-a-kind launch event," as Rockstar calls it, will feature two stages of "non-stop music." GTA 6: The Festival takes place in Miami on November 21. You can't buy tickets. Instead, you need to enter a lottery and hope to be chosen. The lottery is open now and closes tomorrow, November 10, at 4 PM ET. Winners will be drawn the same day, and they can buy tickets on November 11. There is a two-ticket maximum, tickets are non-transferable, and you must be 17 or older to attend. titulo: GTA 6 Preloading Is Officially Live, Files Mention Multiplayer And PS5 Pro Features
texto: At long last, you can now install Grand Theft Auto 6 on your console via preloading , or at least you can if you live in Australia or New Zealand. Preloading begins in all regions at midnight local time, so people in the US are almost there. With preloading now live, people have dug through the files and found things they weren't intended to see. That includes references to things like "join Session," "launch Activity," and "launch Multiplayer Activity." People are taking these to be references to a new form of GTA Online. https://twitter.com/PlaystationSize/status/2119602091630944609 Rockstar has said GTA 6 is a single-player game, but it’s expected to add some form of online multiplayer at some point. titulo: Can You Upgrade To GTA 6’s $100 Edition? Yes, And It’s Easy–Here’s How
texto: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19. If you're planning to buy the $80 edition but want to upgrade later to the $100 version, you might be interested to know if such a thing is possible. Thankfully, yes, it is-and it's very easy to do. Rockstar will offer an "Ultimate Edition Upgrade" for $20, so for anyone who buys the $80 version and decides they do want the additional perks, they can upgrade. This applies to both the digital edition of GTA 6 that you can buy from the Xbox and PlayStation stores, as well the code-in-a-box physical edition. You can get a haircut like this at Sara's Unisex Hair Salon, which is exclusive to the $100 edition. The $100 Ultimate Edition, which is not sold in stores, includes a lot of extras, including vehicles, weapons, clothing for your in-game characters . titulo: GTA 6 Is Going All Out On Details You Might Never Even Notice
texto: It's the smallest details that stand out most in Grand Theft Auto 6 , and thanks to all the screenshots that developer Rockstar Games has posted since the game was officially announced, there's been no shortage of stuff to analyze. Last week, senior video producer Jake Dekker grabbed all 99 of those official screenshots--with the number of images increasing this week thanks to a new screenshot dump--and started going through each and every single one of them. He found plenty of cool little secrets hidden in each image, from legal tender celebrating paranoia to surprisingly realistic flesh, and this week, he's back with another look at GTA 6's impressive attention to detail. Some of these include colorful iguana lizards dotted around Vice City, references to real-life abandoned bridge projects, and local hangouts where you can catch some downtime between heists.
